verdict.rationale: Helicone ships official integrations/SDKs (OpenAI-compatible SDK, plus one-line integrations for OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Gemini, Vercel AI SDK) documented in both docs and GitHub, and community users corroborate quick, reliable SDK-based onboarding ("one line to swap out the OpenAI API", "onboarded in 2 minutes"). Missing for 10: explicit per-language SDK reference docs (e.g., dedicated Python/Node SDK API reference) and independent benchmarking beyond anecdotal community praise.
